about: What a run of bun_fs_slice prints on a host that is not Linux where expected/linux.jsonl has something else. compare-run.ts and expected.ts read this file. A step is named as in the output; a step with a path is "<step> <path>". "absent": steps of Linux that the host does not have. "only_here": steps that only this host has, and the step of Linux they follow. A line of the output that starts with {"detail" is not compared on any host.

symlink a/link -> renamed.txt.why: Windows makes a symbolic link for an administrator, or for everybody when Developer Mode is on: libuv reports ERROR_PRIVILEGE_NOT_HELD as EPERM

unlink, directory a/side.why: libuv's unlink for Windows refuses a directory with ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, which is EPERM (vendor/libuv/src/win/fs.c, fs__unlink), as Node.js does on Windows

steps: renameat2, no replace, destination exists a/renamed.txt -> a/copy.txt
read what was written through the second descriptor
absent.why: steps of POSIX (src/posix.rs of the slice)

errno.why: the number of an error is compared on Linux and on macOS

unlink, directory a/side.why: unlink(2) of macOS gives EPERM for a directory

stat, times a/renamed.txt.why: macOS keeps the time a file was made. Linux's struct stat has none, and bun takes the time of the last change of status there, as libuv does: the rename of the file is later than its last write

errno.why: the number of an error is the one of macOS

only_here.after: read what was written through the second descriptor

steps.step: clonefile, destination exists, the copy is as it was
path of a descriptor, of a directory
path of a descriptor that is closed

only_here.why: steps of macOS (src/macos.rs of the slice): clonefile and its fallback copyfile, fcopyfile, fcntl(F_GETPATH)

every_host.syscall: the name of the system call that bun attributes an error to is compared on Linux only: bun's code for another OS reaches the same result through other calls
every_host.detail: a line that starts with {"detail" says how something went on the machine (which way a copy was made, the error number that macOS gave): it is not compared
